verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs describe built-in search and download via Hugging Face, plus running the downloaded models locally from both the app and the CLI (`lms get`, `lms load`). A hands-on community report confirms you can search Hugging Face in the app and the model downloads and works. Another user notes that some Hugging Face models are not listed, with no explanation given. missing for 10: coverage of the full Hugging Face catalog (some models reportedly not listed), and detailed docs on supported model formats.
